section.content: 本发明公开了机器学习建模图像识别的人工智能技术，涉及图像处理技术领域，本发明包括图像采集模块、图像传输模块、图像处理模块以及人工智能模块；图像采集模块主要用于采集数字图像，图像传输模块主要用于传输数字图像，图像处理模块主要用于对数字图像进行预处理，然后对预处理后的图像进行分割，对分割后的字图像进行编码，将编码后的图像发送至人工智能模块，人工智能模块通过建立神经网络模型对编码后的图像进行学习并验证，最终输出神经网络模型。本发明为机器学习建模图像识别的人工智能技术，有着图像处理识别运算量小，识别精度高，识别速率快的优点。

The invention discloses an artificial intelligence technology for identifying machine learning modeling images, which relates to the technical field of image processing, and comprises an image acquisition module, an image transmission module, an image processing module and an artificial intelligence module; the image acquisition module is mainly used for acquiring digital images, the image transmission module is mainly used for transmitting the digital images, the image processing module is mainly used for preprocessing the digital images, then segmenting the preprocessed images, encoding the segmented digital images, sending the encoded images to the artificial intelligence module, and the artificial intelligence module learns and verifies the encoded images by establishing a neural network model and finally outputs the neural network model. The invention is an artificial intelligence technology for machine learning modeling image recognition, and has the advantages of small image processing recognition operand, high recognition precision and high recognition rate.

Artificial intelligence technology for machine learning modeling image recognitionTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, in particular to an artificial intelligence technology for identifying machine learning modeling images.

Background

Machine learning is a multi-field cross discipline, and relates to a plurality of disciplines such as probability theory, statistics, approximation theory, convex analysis, algorithm complexity theory and the like. The method is characterized in that a special research is carried out on how a computer simulates or realizes human learning behaviors to acquire new knowledge or skills, and the existing knowledge structure is reorganized to continuously improve the performance of the computer, so that the method is an artificial intelligence core, is a fundamental approach for enabling the computer to have intelligence, and often needs an image recognition technology in the machine learning process.

CN105740878B2 discloses a symbol recognition method for a geographic information system, wherein: determining the feature type and attribute information of each subgraph in the symbol to be matched according to the geometric shape feature information extracted from the symbol to be matched, wherein each symbol to be matched comprises at least one subgraph; according to the feature type of each subgraph, a matching result is determined according to the context feature information of the symbol to be matched.

In the field of license plate recognition of parking lots, an existing image recognition method is to convert an image into a bitmap, convert the bitmap into a gray image, convert the gray image into a binary image, convert the binary image into a character string, and compare the character string, wherein all pixel points of the whole image need to be processed in the process, in the process of processing, each symbol needs to be re-recognized during symbol recognition, corresponding information is obtained, the calculation amount is large, a large amount of resources are consumed, and the accuracy of calculation results is low.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention mainly aims to provide an artificial intelligence technology for identifying machine learning modeling images, which can effectively solve the problems in the background technology.

In order to achieve the purpose, the invention adopts the technical scheme that: an artificial intelligence technology for identifying machine learning modeling images is characterized in that: the system comprises an image acquisition module, an image transmission module, an image processing module and an artificial intelligence module;

the system comprises an image acquisition module, an image transmission module, an image processing module, an artificial intelligence module and a neural network model, wherein the image acquisition module is mainly used for acquiring digital images, the image transmission module is mainly used for transmitting the digital images, the image processing module is mainly used for preprocessing the digital images, then segmenting the preprocessed images, coding the segmented digital images, and sending the coded images to the artificial intelligence module, and the artificial intelligence module learns and verifies the coded images by establishing the neural network model and finally outputs the neural network model;

the image processing module comprises a preprocessing unit, a segmentation unit and a coding unit; the preprocessing unit is mainly used for preprocessing the image;

the segmentation unit is mainly used for segmenting the digital image A to obtain an image array (a) 1 、a 2 、a 3 、...、a n ) The specific process is as follows: in the segmentation process, firstly, calculating a three-component histogram of a digital image A to be segmented, and respectively carrying out primary processing on the three-component histogram so as to keep the waveform of each histogram smooth; secondly, searching wave troughs in each histogram by adopting a wave crest and wave trough quick positioning algorithm, and performing multi-level threshold segmentation on each histogram by taking the wave troughs as thresholds; recombining the segmented histograms again to construct a new one-dimensional histogram, then obtaining wave troughs of the new one-dimensional histogram by adopting a wave crest and wave trough rapid positioning algorithm for the second time, and determining an initial clustering center through secondary multi-stage division; finally, pre-dividing the digital image A by adopting a watershed algorithm through an initial clustering center, using the obtained divided areas as sub-images, carrying out area numbering, and finally obtaining an image array (a) 1 、a 2 、a 3 、...、a n ) For example, the license plate number AB123 is subjected to image segmentation to finally obtain five sub-images, each sub-image respectively comprises "a", "B", "1", "2" and "3", the step is mainly used for separating characters in a whole digital image to obtain a plurality of sub-images respectively comprising each character, and the accuracy of recognition is improved by performing image recognition processing on each sub-image instead of performing image recognition processing on the whole image, so that the recognition accuracy is greatly improved;

the coding unit is used for coding the sub-image a in the image array i (i is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to n) to carry out binary coding, and sub-image a is selected i (i is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to n) the point with the pixel value of 1 at the bottom right corner is taken as a starting point, the starting point is taken as the center of a circle, a certain length r is taken as the radius, and a circle O is drawn 1 Circle of O 1 Taking any one of two intersection points with the edge image as an end point, and recording an included angle B between a connecting line of the end point and the start point and the X axis 1 Selecting the end point as a new starting point, and making a circle O with the same length r as the radius 2 Circle of O 2 One of two intersection points with the edge image is a circle O 2 The other intersection point is a new end point, and an included angle B between the new center of the circle and the new end point and the X axis is recorded 2 Repeating the above steps to obtain a coding array (B) of the edge image 1 、B 2 、B 3 、...、B n ) Performing binary conversion according to the angle of the coding array of the edge image to obtain a binary array C 1 、C 2 、C 3 、...、C n ) The symbol edge image obtained in the coding unit in the mode is digitized, compared with the traditional bitmap and a dot matrix image, the data volume is greatly reduced, the data operation amount is reduced, and only the radius value r needs to be amplified in equal proportion along with the equal-proportion amplification of the edge image, so that the accuracy of image identification is improved, and the operation amount is greatly reduced because all pixel points do not need to be subjected to binary coding;

the artificial intelligence module firstly establishes a neural network learning model, and binary number groups are taken as C in the neural network learning model 1 、C 2 、C 3 、...、C n ) Inputting a neural network learning model for a learning object, outputting a corresponding recognition result through the neural network learning model, manually judging whether the recognition result is accurate in an initial state, if not, adjusting the hyper-parameters of the neural network learning model, and continuing to use the binary array C 1 、C 2 、C 3 、...、C n ) The neural network learning model is input as a learning object, the hyper-parameters of the neural network learning model are adjusted again until an accurate recognition result is output, and the neural network model automatically completes result recognition according to binary coding, so that the result recognition is more accurate, the recognition is more intelligent, and the recognition rate is high.

Preferably, the image acquisition module captures a license plate image through an acquisition camera, for example, a camera at an entrance of a parking lot is used to capture the license plate image.

Preferably, the image transmission module comprises a first sending unit and a first receiving unit, the first sending unit is mainly used for sending the digital image shot by the image acquisition module, the image processing module obtains the digital image sent by the first sending unit through the first receiving unit, and the digital image is directly coded and transmitted in the sending process of the digital image, so that distortion is avoided in the transmission process of the digital image, and the accuracy of the digital image in the primary transmission process is ensured.

Preferably, the preprocessing unit is mainly used for preprocessing the image, specifically including gray value processing of the image, setting a comparison threshold G, and comparing the gray value of each pixel point with a regional gray standard value G; when the gray value of the pixel point is larger than or equal to G, the pixel point is judged to be a white point, and the gray value of the pixel point is adjusted to be a preset white brightness constant; when the gray value of a pixel point is smaller than G, the pixel point is judged to be a black point, the gray value of the pixel point is adjusted to be a preset black brightness constant, a gray value image is finally obtained, the gray value image is used as a preprocessed image, and a comparison threshold G is obtained by calculating in the following mode.

Preferably, the first sending unit and the first receiving unit are connected through wireless WIFI, so that image transmission is realized through wireless WIFI, image transmission is realized through WIFI connection, and a transmission effect is ensured.

Preferably, an image storage database is established for storing different license plate images acquired by the image acquisition module for multiple times, and an inquiry mechanism and a protection mechanism are established for the image storage database, wherein the inquiry mechanism is mainly used for inquiring records of vehicle entering in the past process in the image storage database, and the protection mechanism mainly adopts database safety protection measures, so that illegal invasion can be effectively prevented.

Preferably, the artificial intelligence module establishes a learning result library, the learning result library is mainly used for storing the identification result accurately output every time in the neural network learning model, and when the license plate is shot and identified for the second time, the artificial intelligence module directly calls the identification result in the learning result library and then directly outputs the identification result, so that the improvement is further realized.

Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following beneficial effects:

in the invention, by arranging the coding unit, the coding unit carries out coding on the sub-image a in the image array i (i is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to n) is binary coded, and a sub-image a is selected i (i is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to n) the point with the pixel value of 1 at the bottom right corner is taken as a starting point, the starting point is taken as the center of a circle, a certain length r is taken as the radius, and a circle O is drawn 1 Circle of O 1 Taking any one of two intersection points with the edge image as an end point, and recording an included angle B between a connecting line of the end point and the start point and the X axis 1 Selecting the end point as a new starting point, and making a circle O with the same length r as the radius 2 Circle of O 2 One of two intersection points with the edge image is a circle O 2 The other intersection point is a new end point, and an included angle B between the new center of the circle and the new end point and the X axis is recorded 2 Repeating the above steps to obtain an edge imageCode array (B) 1 、B 2 、B 3 、...、B n ) Performing binary conversion according to the angle of the coding array of the edge image to obtain a binary array C 1 、C 2 、C 3 、...、C n ) The symbol edge image obtained in the coding unit in the mode is digitized, compared with a traditional bitmap and a dot matrix image, the data volume is greatly reduced, the data operation amount is reduced, and only the radius value r needs to be amplified in an equal proportion along with the equal proportion amplification of the edge image, so that the accuracy of image identification is improved, and the operation amount is greatly reduced because binary coding is not needed to be carried out on all pixel points.

In the invention, an artificial intelligence module is set, in the artificial intelligence module, firstly a neural network learning model is set up, a binary array is used as a learning object in the neural network learning model and is input into the neural network learning model, a corresponding recognition result is output through the neural network learning model, whether the recognition result is accurate or not is manually judged in an initial state, if the recognition result is not accurate, the hyper-parameter of the neural network learning model is adjusted, the binary array is continuously used as the learning object and is input into the neural network learning model, the hyper-parameter of the neural network learning model is adjusted again until an accurate recognition result is output, and the result recognition is automatically completed according to binary codes through the neural network model, so that the result recognition is more accurate, the recognition is more intelligent, and the recognition rate is high.

Detailed Description

In order to make the technical means, the creation characteristics, the achievement purposes and the effects of the invention easy to understand, the invention is further described with the specific embodiments.

In the description of the present invention, it should be noted that the terms "upper", "lower", "inner", "outer", "front", "rear", "both ends", "one end", "the other end", and the like indicate orientations or positional relationships based on those shown in the drawings, and are only for convenience of description and simplicity of description, but do not indicate or imply that the referred device or element must have a specific orientation, be constructed in a specific orientation, and be operated, and thus, should not be construed as limiting the present invention. Furthermore, the terms "first," "second," and the like are used for descriptive purposes only and are not to be construed as indicating or implying relative importance.

In the description of the present invention, it is to be noted that, unless otherwise explicitly specified or limited, the terms "mounted," "disposed," "connected," and the like are to be construed broadly, such as "connected," which may be fixedly connected, detachably connected, or integrally connected; can be mechanically or electrically connected; they may be connected directly or indirectly through intervening media, or they may be interconnected between two elements. The specific meanings of the above terms in the present invention can be understood in specific cases to those skilled in the art.

the image processing module comprises a preprocessing unit, a segmentation unit and a coding unit; the preprocessing unit is mainly used for preprocessing the image;

The image acquisition module shoots license plate images through the acquisition camera, for example, the camera at the entrance of the parking lot is used for shooting the license plate images.

The image transmission module comprises a first sending unit and a first receiving unit, the first sending unit is mainly used for sending the digital image shot by the image acquisition module, the image processing module obtains the digital image sent by the first sending unit through the first receiving unit and directly performs coding transmission in the digital image sending process, distortion is avoided in the digital image transmission process, and accuracy in the primary transmission process of the digital image is guaranteed.

The preprocessing unit is mainly used for preprocessing the image, specifically comprises gray value processing of the image, setting a comparison threshold G and comparing the gray value of each pixel point with a regional gray standard value G; when the gray value of the pixel point is larger than or equal to G, the pixel point is judged to be a white point, and the gray value of the pixel point is adjusted to be a preset white brightness constant; when the gray value of a pixel point is smaller than G, the pixel point is judged to be a black point, the gray value of the pixel point is adjusted to be a preset black brightness constant, a gray value image is finally obtained, the gray value image is used as a preprocessed image, a contrast threshold G is obtained through calculation in the following mode, firstly, all line thresholds G [ i ] of a digital image A are added and divided by a total line number n to obtain an area gray level standard value G of a fixed area in a frame image, the standard value G is the contrast threshold G, the original color image is converted into a gray value image with only black and white colors through gray value processing of the image, the operation amount in the image processing process is reduced again, and the operation rate is further improved.

The first sending unit and the first receiving unit are connected through wireless WIFI, image transmission is achieved through WIFI connection, and the transmission effect is guaranteed.

The system comprises an image acquisition module, an image storage database, a query mechanism and a protection mechanism, wherein the image storage database is established for storing different license plate images acquired by the image acquisition module for multiple times, the query mechanism is mainly used for querying records of vehicle entering in the past process in the image storage database, and the protection mechanism mainly adopts database safety protection measures and can effectively prevent illegal invasion.

The artificial intelligence module establishes a learning result library which is mainly used for storing the identification result accurately output every time in the neural network learning model, and when the license plate is shot and identified for the second time, the artificial intelligence module directly calls the identification result in the learning result library and then directly outputs the identification result, so that the improvement is further realized.

The foregoing shows and describes the general principles and broad features of the present invention and advantages thereof. It will be understood by those skilled in the art that the present invention is not limited to the embodiments described above, which are given by way of illustration of the principles of the present invention, but that various changes and modifications may be made without departing from the spirit and scope of the invention, and such changes and modifications are within the scope of the invention as claimed.
